#MSNews | Police forces in Metro Manila were alerted to ensure that sufficient security assistance will be provided to the public assemblies that will be held every Friday, starting October 10, acting Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief, Police Lieutenant General Jose Melencio Nartatez, Jr., said.

The acting PNP chief said that police commanders in Metro Manila and other areas where public assemblies would be held were already advised to prepare to ensure the safety of those who would join, including coordination with the organizers.

“We understand the importance of these activities for people who seek the truth, for people who seek justice, for people who call for justice amid allegations of wrongdoings involving taxpayers’ money,” according to Nartatez.

“On the part of the PNP, our police commanders on the ground, especially in Metro Manila, were already alerted of these series of protests every Friday leading to the November 30 rally,” he added. | via Vince Lopez

📷 PNP-PIO
